about: openLab's own icons where they are drawn: the list's status marks (playhead, broken red X, flagged, running, paused, preview, auto-continue and auto-follow), selected and not; the sidebar transport strip; Active Cues with its pause and panic buttons; the Warnings list; the footer's toggles, settings and status; the inspector's Target field buttons; the time headers' chevrons (right counting up, left counting down after a click on the Duration header).
